title: Portable Diagram Explorer project
description: Canonical project data: diagrams over imported raster images, clickable rectangular hotspots and text annotations.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file format. This application reads versions 1 and 2 and migrates version 1 to 2 on open, so the value checked here is always 2.

sequence.description: Optional running order: the diagrams shown one after another in a presentation, independent of hotspot links.

items.description: An opaque, stable identifier: 1–64 letters, digits, "-" or "_", starting with a letter or digit. It never encodes parentage or a filename.

slides.description: Diagram IDs in presentation order. Each must name a diagram in "diagrams" and appear at most once. Omit "sequence" entirely for no running order.

projectId.description: An opaque, stable identifier: 1–64 letters, digits, "-" or "_", starting with a letter or digit. It never encodes parentage or a filename.

title.description: Project title, shown in the presentation and used for file names.

rootDiagramId.description: ID of the overview diagram the presentation opens on. It must name a diagram in "diagrams".

metadata.description: Optional descriptive metadata. Never used as an identity key.

assets.description: Image files used by diagrams. Several diagrams may share one asset.

diagrams.description: The diagrams. Navigation between them is a graph: cross-links and cycles are allowed.

tooltipDelayMs.description: Delay before a hover tooltip appears, in milliseconds.

showHotspotHints.description: Whether hotspot outlines are visible in presentation mode.

asset.description: One imported image file, stored unchanged.

id.description: An opaque, stable identifier: 1–64 letters, digits, "-" or "_", starting with a letter or digit. It never encodes parentage or a filename.

path.description: Package-relative path of the image file: "assets/" followed by lowercase letters, digits, ".", "_" or "-". No absolute or parent paths.

mimeType.description: Image type. Accepted: PNG, JPEG, WebP and SVG.

width.description: Displayed width in pixels after orientation is applied.

height.description: Displayed height in pixels after orientation is applied.

diagram.description: One diagram: an image plus its hotspots and annotations.

id.description: An opaque, stable identifier: 1–64 letters, digits, "-" or "_", starting with a letter or digit. It never encodes parentage or a filename.

title.description: Diagram title, shown in breadcrumbs and the modal header.

assetId.description: ID of the image asset this diagram displays. It must name an entry in "assets".

description.description: Optional plain-text description of the diagram.

alignmentReviewRequired.description: Set when the image was replaced with different dimensions; the author must review hotspot alignment before export.

annotations.description: Visible text notes placed on this diagram.

hotspot.description: A rectangular clickable region over a component.

id.description: An opaque, stable identifier: 1–64 letters, digits, "-" or "_", starting with a letter or digit. It never encodes parentage or a filename.

label.description: Accessible name of the component, read by screen readers and shown in menus.

tooltip.description: Short text shown on hover and keyboard focus.

x.description: Left edge, as a fraction of the image size (0 = left/top edge, 1 = right/bottom edge).

y.description: Top edge, as a fraction of the image size (0 = left/top edge, 1 = right/bottom edge).

width.description: Width, as a positive fraction of the image size; position plus size may not exceed 1.

height.description: Height, as a positive fraction of the image size; position plus size may not exceed 1.

zIndex.description: Stacking order; where hotspots overlap, the highest receives the click.

defaultActionId.description: ID of the action a click performs. Null or absent means a click shows the action menu.

actions.description: What the component offers, in menu order.

action.description: One menu choice: open a diagram, or show a text description.

diagramAction.description: Opens another diagram in the drill-down modal.

id.description: An opaque, stable identifier: 1–64 letters, digits, "-" or "_", starting with a letter or digit. It never encodes parentage or a filename.

type.description: Action type. Version 1 supports "diagram" and "details" only.

targetDiagramId.description: ID of the diagram to open. It must name a diagram in "diagrams".

detailsAction.description: Shows plain text in the details panel.

id.description: An opaque, stable identifier: 1–64 letters, digits, "-" or "_", starting with a letter or digit. It never encodes parentage or a filename.

type.description: Action type. Version 1 supports "diagram" and "details" only.

text.description: Plain text shown in the details panel; line breaks are kept.

annotation.description: Visible text placed on the diagram, separate from tooltips.

id.description: An opaque, stable identifier: 1–64 letters, digits, "-" or "_", starting with a letter or digit. It never encodes parentage or a filename.

examples: Account IDs come from the internal system.
text.description: Plain text; line breaks are kept.

x.description: Left edge, as a fraction of the image size (0 = left/top edge, 1 = right/bottom edge).

y.description: Top edge, as a fraction of the image size (0 = left/top edge, 1 = right/bottom edge).

width.description: Text box width, as a positive fraction of the image size; position plus size may not exceed 1.
